title: FlowML
description: FlowML YAML schema for Salesforce Flow transpilation

name.description: Flow API name — letters, numbers, and underscores only; must start with a letter

trigger.description: Record-triggered or scheduled flow trigger configuration

start.description: Screen or autolaunched flow start configuration

variables.description: Variable declarations keyed by variable name

formulas.description: Formula declarations keyed by formula name

textTemplates.description: Text template declarations keyed by template name

constants.description: Constant declarations keyed by constant name

choiceSets.description: Dynamic choice set declarations keyed by choice set name

type.description: Which kind of choice set this is: dynamicPicklist (choices from a picklist field — set picklistObject + field) or recordChoice (choices from records or a record collection — object is required). Both serialize to <dynamicChoiceSets>. Closed set — a FlowML discriminator, not a Salesforce enum.

choices.description: Static choice declarations keyed by choice name

steps.description: Flow step definitions — each step is identified by its type key (lookup, decision, assignment, etc.)

conditionList.description: A list of conditions — array of condition strings (AND logic), object with logic+conditions (complex logic), or numbered object map (used in decision rules where conditionLogic is a sibling property)

repeaterField.description: Repeating group of nested screen fields

lookupStep.description: Query records from a Salesforce object

items.description: Flat field API name only — relationship paths like Contact.Email are not valid in queriedFields; use storeOutputAutomatically: true or a second lookup

decisionStep.description: Branch flow execution based on conditions

assignmentStep.description: Set variable values with assignment operations

loopStep.description: Iterate over a collection of records or values

filterStep.description: Filter a collection based on conditions

transformStep.description: Transform or aggregate collection data (map, sort, reduce)

actionStep.description: Invoke an action (Apex, email alert, quick action, etc.)

subflowStep.description: Call another flow as a subflow

screenStep.description: Display an interactive screen to the user

customErrorStep.description: Custom error message step for before-save validation

recordLockStep.description: Lock or unlock records for approval processes

recordRollbackStep.description: Roll back pending DML in screen flows

rawStep.description: Raw XML pass-through for unsupported element types
